title: Goat Milking Yield Consistency
dataSources: Beehive weight and entrance activity (`beehive:weight`), hive climate (`beehive:climate`), brooder climate (`brooder:climate`), egg counts (`coop:egg`), rain-barrel level (`rainbarrel:level`), greenhouse climate (`greenhouse:climate`), orchard bloom observations (`orchard:bloom`), and milking logs (`milking:session`).
app: Homestead telemetry from beehive monitors, coop sensors, brooder controls, greenhouse sensors, rain barrels, orchard logs, and milking records streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, LoRaWAN, and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=milking:session
| stats avg(liters) as avg_liters stdev(liters) as yield_stdev_liters by animal_id
| sort - avg_liters
description: Shows average yield and variability per animal so health, feed, and routine changes are easier to notice.
value: Consistency tells a richer story than one big milking day, making this a useful animal-health trend for small homesteads.
implementation: Record each milking session with animal identifier and litres collected in a simple mobile form or dairy app export.
visualization: Bar chart of average yield with variability by animal.
grandmaExplanation: It measures whether each milking animal is producing steadily or starting to vary more than usual.
